subject.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: textSignature bloat + think tags + mixed text/tool causes session failures

question: Should direct Google/Gemini replay keep text-part thought signatures in textSignature for same-model continuity, or strip/offload them to prevent session bloat?
rationale: Current source preserves textSignature for Google same-model replay, but the issue shows those opaque blobs can accumulate until context, compaction, and Telegram delivery fail.

options.title: Preserve with bounded storage
options.body: Keep Google continuity semantics but move large text signatures out of replayed session content or enforce a bounded replay policy with bloat and tool-turn tests.

options.title: Strip text signatures
options.body: Delete same-route textSignature replay for Google text parts and accept the risk that some Gemini continuity behavior may regress.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Treat the bloat as acceptable provider behavior and document the operator workaround and session/cost tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Preserve with bounded storage
recommendation.body: Keep Google continuity semantics but move large text signatures out of replayed session content or enforce a bounded replay policy with bloat and tool-turn tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest recent owner for the Google transport/plugin path that currently captures and replays these signatures.
